title: HostRecord
description: Normalized record representing an enumerated or resolved host within target scope.

host.description: Fully qualified domain name or hostname of the discovered entity.

target.description: Root assessment target domain that this host is in scope for.

ip.description: Associated IP address or comma-separated list of resolved IP addresses.

source.description: Discovery source or tool (e.g. subdomain, dnsx, assetfinder).
